::: {.teaching-hero-text}
I approach teaching biostatistics as translation work — taking rigorous methods and making them usable by students who arrive with very different quantitative backgrounds, from undergraduate honors students to graduate students in biostatistics, epidemiology, and nursing. Whether leading a course, guest lecturing, or working one-on-one as a TA, I try to keep the material grounded in the applied public health problems — HIV care outcomes, health equity, structural determinants of health — that drew me to it in the first place.
:::

:::

## Teaching Experience

Courses taught, guest lectures, and teaching assistantships. Organized by role, then institution/department.

<script>
(function () {
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lorenz-canvas");
  if (!canvas || !canvas.getContext) return;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  // ---- 1. Generate the attractor's trajectory once, up front ----
  // The Lorenz system: a simple set of three coupled equations that
  // produces the classic "butterfly" chaotic attractor. Integrated
  // here with 4th-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) for a smooth curve — no
  // charting/animation library needed, it's just arithmetic.
  var sigma = 10, rho = 28, beta = 8 / 3;
  function derivatives(x, y, z) {
    return [sigma * (y - x), x * (rho - z) - y, x * y - beta * z];
  }

  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  var dt = 0.008;
  var steps = reduceMotion ? 6000 : 9000; // fewer points needed for a single static frame
  var burnIn = 200; // discard the initial approach from the arbitrary start point

  var x = 0.1, y = 0, z = 0;
  var points = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    var k1 = derivatives(x, y, z);
    var k2 = derivatives(x + dt / 2 * k1[0], y + dt / 2 * k1[1], z + dt / 2 * k1[2]);
    var k3 = derivatives(x + dt / 2 * k2[0], y + dt / 2 * k2[1], z + dt / 2 * k2[2]);
    var k4 = derivatives(x + dt * k3[0], y + dt * k3[1], z + dt * k3[2]);
    x += dt / 6 * (k1[0] + 2 * k2[0] + 2 * k3[0] + k4[0]);
    y += dt / 6 * (k1[1] + 2 * k2[1] + 2 * k3[1] + k4[1]);
    z += dt / 6 * (k1[2] + 2 * k2[2] + 2 * k3[2] + k4[2]);
    if (i >= burnIn) points.push([x, y, z]);
  }

  // Normalize so the trajectory fills the canvas regardless of the
  // exact shape these particular parameters/starting point produce.
  var minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity, minZ = Infinity, maxZ = -Infinity;
  points.forEach(function (p) {
    if (p[0] < minX) minX = p[0]; if (p[0] > maxX) maxX = p[0];
    if (p[1] < minY) minY = p[1]; if (p[1] > maxY) maxY = p[1];
    if (p[2] < minZ) minZ = p[2]; if (p[2] > maxZ) maxZ = p[2];
  });
  var midX = (minX + maxX) / 2, midY = (minY + maxY) / 2, midZ = (minZ + maxZ) / 2;
  var span = Math.max(maxX - minX, maxY - minY, maxZ - minZ) || 1;
  points = points.map(function (p) {
    return [p[0] - midX, p[1] - midY, p[2] - midZ];
  });

  // Warm color sweep across the trajectory (drawn as a handful of
  // solid-color bands rather than a per-point gradient, so each
  // animation frame only needs a few stroke() calls, not thousands).
  var bandColors = ["#c9a227", "#b8860b", "#7a1f2b", "#9c3a4a", "#d9808c", "#e8a0ac"];
  var bandCount = bandColors.length;
  var bandSize = Math.ceil(points.length / bandCount);

  // ---- 2. Render: rotate the point cloud a little each frame and redraw ----
  function resize() {
    var rect = canvas.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
    canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    return { w: rect.width, h: rect.height };
  }

  var size = resize();
  var angle = 0.6; // starting rotation, purely aesthetic

  function draw() {
    var w = size.w, h = size.h;
    var scale = (Math.min(w, h) / span) * 1.7;
    var cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2 + h * 0.05;
    var cosA = Math.cos(angle), sinA = Math.sin(angle);

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    for (var b = 0; b < bandCount; b++) {
      var start = b * bandSize;
      var end = Math.min(start + bandSize + 1, points.length); // +1 so bands connect with no gap
      if (start >= points.length) break;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var i = start; i < end; i++) {
        var p = points[i];
        var rx = p[0] * cosA - p[2] * sinA;
        var sx = cx + rx * scale;
        var sy = cy - p[1] * scale;
        if (i === start) ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
        else ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = bandColors[b];
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  draw();

  if (!reduceMotion) {
    (function animate() {
      angle += 0.0022;
      draw();
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    })();
  }

  window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
    size = resize();
    draw();
  });
})();
</script>
